Name: A Quality Mod
Author: spacechase0
Description:
[b]A Quality Mod[/b] adds two new quality tiers - poor, and wonderful.

Poor items are below normal quality, and sell for only 50% of their normal price. Wonderful items are above iridium quality and sell for 250% of their normal price.

Wonderful items can be obtained by aging iridium items in a cask for 14 days. Poor items can't be obtained without other mods.

There is an API for other mods to check for the new qualities, and make items have the new qualities.

Icons courtesy of Kin#9297 on Discord. Idea by Shockah on Nexus.

[b][size=5]Install[/size][/b]
[list=1]
[*]Install the latest version of [url=https://smapi.io]SMAPI[/url].
[*]Unzip the mod folder into [font=Courier New]Stardew Valley/Mods[/font].
[*]Run the game using SMAPI.

[/list]

[b][size=5]Compatibility[/size][/b]
Compatible with Stardew Valley 1.5.5+ on Linux/macOS/Windows, both single-player and multiplayer.
